seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 steps 6px (A1-4) in the field; it is blocked by any wall pixel in the destination box unless the box holds the plate centre. The first input at counter w=64 is a no-op.
Counter w = 64-(n+1)//2, where n = actions so far. The parity is hidden, so the model is carried across calls only while the state stays continuous.
When the player or ghost covers the 3x3 plate, the door (densest 5x5 window) slides 6px toward the arm. The wall is re-extracted with occlusion by the 5x5 layer-1 boxes.
A5 after a move: if there is no ghost, record the life path as a ghost (red hud icon at (1,1), old huds x+4); otherwise clear it. Then respawn at (14,8). Ghost = path[k-1] after k moves, hidden when on the player. Names = type_%03d in list order, wall last.
Not confirmed: spawn constant, field bounds, the ghost past the end of its path (clamped), and the stateless door/plate inverse when the plate is occluded. Stateless replay scores 15/35.
